correctness.rationale: Rebuilt all graph vertices as 2/3-subsets of five labels and the containment edges, independently computed its diameter five and enumerated all 260 and 3200 faces at radii 2 and 3. Fetched the actual 25,113-byte morse_certificate.json blob (SHA fa3ce12f...) and independently matched every face with either one of 120 and 1599 disjoint codimension-one pairs or exactly 20 and 2 critical simplices, respectively. Reconstructed the full oriented Hasse diagrams and topologically sorted all vertices, proving each matching acyclic; critical dimensions are {0:1,2:19} and {0:1,3:1}. Discrete Morse thus yields the asserted integral wedge structures. Radius four excludes exactly ten complementary pairs and is the join of ten S0, hence S9. Independently enumerated all 240 S5×C2 elements, every setwise fixed face, and signed Lefschetz traces at radii 1,2,3: all agree with the exact stated Specht-character formulas. Remaining filtration, persistence and rational quotient conclusions follow by distinct homological degrees and invariant averaging. These are exhaustive finite checks of exact certificates, not extrapolations from samples.
